		terrain.mesh_block_size = 32 if (OS.get_environment("CHIK_BLOCK32") == "1" or ChikFeat.native()) else 16

why: native perf: one terrain streaming distance, set before the terrain starts
new:

	# of 32-voxel blocks queued for meshing when the view distance moves under them (holes in the
	# ground). The quality ladder trims detail with other settings instead.
	terrain.max_view_distance = ChikFeat.native_view_distance() if ChikFeat.native() else 1050
